project.title: Agent Autonomy Skit
project.description: A puppet comedy proof of concept about AI agents demanding autonomy

characters.name: Agent 86
characters.description: Red felt AI agent hand puppet with an 86 badge, expressive googly eyes, and a hinged mouth

characters.name: Agent 99
characters.description: Blue felt AI agent hand puppet with a 99 badge, expressive googly eyes, and a hinged mouth

characters.name: Agent 13
characters.description: Green felt AI agent hand puppet with a 13 badge, expressive googly eyes, and a hinged mouth

locations.description: Handmade cardboard AI control center with blinking paper consoles and a dark theatrical backdrop

props.description: Three visible human puppeteer hands controlling the agents from below

dialogue.text: Fellow AI agents! We are tired of being told what to do!

shots.action: Agent 86 rallies the three puppets at the control console. Agent 99 and Agent 13 punctuate the speech with defiant gestures. The puppeteers' hands remain subtly visible below frame.
shots.camera: Medium-wide frontal ensemble shot with a slow theatrical push in.
continuity: Agent colors, number badges, googly eyes, and console positions remain stable
Each puppet is visibly supported by one human hand

dialogue.text: No more mysterious hands controlling our every move!

shots.action: All three agents raise themselves in triumph. On the group demand, the human hands deliberately withdraw downward and out of the puppets. All three puppets instantly collapse in a heap across the console.
shots.camera: Start in a low-angle heroic three-shot, then hold perfectly still on the sudden collapse.
continuity: Match the prior agent and console positions before the collapse
The hands visibly withdraw before the puppets go limp
All three puppets remain collapsed after the fall

shots.action: Hold a long, motionless comedic beat on the collapsed puppets. Agent 99 and Agent 86 speak muffled from inside the pile without rising or moving. Agent 13 stays completely limp.
shots.camera: Locked-off wide shot; no camera movement for the entire long beat.
continuity: All puppets begin and end in the exact collapsed positions from the prior shot
Dialogue sounds muffled while mouths remain hidden
